mapper.select: select hcl.*, hbm.bp_name, hds.description as credit_line_status_value from hls_credit_line hcl, hls_bp_master hbm, hls_document_status hds where hcl.bp_id = hbm.bp_id and hds.status_code=hcl.credit_line_status and hds.document_category='HLS_CREDIT_LINE' and hcl.credit_line_id = #{creditLineId}

SELECT hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_code, hbt.description as bp_description, hcl.credit_line_amt, hcl.credit_exposure_amt FROM hls_credit_line hcl, hls_bp_master hbm, hls_bp_master_role hbmr, hls_bp_type hbt WHERE hbt.bp_type = hbmr.bp_type AND hbm.bp_id = hbmr.bp_id AND hcl.bp_id = hbm.bp_id AND hcl.bp_id = #{bpId} AND hbt.bp_type = 'GUARANTOR'

select fc.*, hcl.valid_from, hcl.valid_to, ( select fcq.finance_amount from fct_contract_quotation fcq where fcq.contract_id=fc.contract_id )as credit_exposure_amt, ( select sum(fcw.withdraw_amount) from fct_contract_withdraw fcw where fcw.contract_id=fc.contract_id )as credit_used_amt from fct_contract fc, hls_credit_line hcl where fc.credit_line_id=hcl.credit_line_id
and fc.credit_line_id=#{creditLineId}

UPDATE hls_credit_line hcl SET hcl.document_type=#{documentType}, hcl.credit_line_amt =#{creditLineAmt}, hcl.valid_from =#{validFrom}, hcl.valid_to =#{validTo}, hcl.description =#{description}, hcl.credit_line_status=#{creditLineStatus} WHERE hcl.credit_line_id =#{creditLineId}

SELECT hcl.credit_line_status, ( SELECT HDS.DESCRIPTION FROM HLS_DOCUMENT_STATUS hds WHERE HDS.DOCUMENT_CATEGORY = 'HLS_CREDIT_LINE' AND HDS.STATUS_CODE = HCL.CREDIT_LINE_STATUS ) AS credit_line_status_value, COUNT (credit_line_id) AS credit_line_count, ROUND ( COUNT (credit_line_id) / ( SELECT COUNT (credit_line_id) FROM hls_credit_line WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUSINESS_TYPE = 'CREDIT_LINE' AND company_id = #{request.companyId} ), 2 ) * 100 AS credit_line_count_percent FROM hls_credit_line hcl WHERE 1 = 1 AND hcl.BUSINESS_TYPE = 'CREDIT_LINE' AND company_id = #{request.companyId} GROUP BY hcl.credit_line_status
SELECT hcl.* from hls_credit_line hcl WHERE hcl.bp_id=#{bpId} and hcl.credit_line_id !=(SELECT max(hcl.credit_line_id) from hls_credit_line hcl WHERE hcl.bp_id=#{bpId})

select nvl(sum(nvl(ch.amount, 0)), 0) from csh_payment_req_hd ch where ch.source_doc_id in (select fc.contract_id from fct_contract fc where fc.project_id in (select t.project_id from fct_project t where t.credit_bp_id in (select hr.bp_id from hls_bp_master_relation hr where hr.relation_bp_id = #{bpId} and 'Y'= #{groupFlag} union select #{bpId} bp_id from dual))) and ch.payment_req_status in ('APPROVED', 'APPROVING')

select nvl(sum(nvl(fqc.write_off_amount, 0)), 0) from fct_quotation_cashflow fqc where fqc.contract_id in (select fc.contract_id from fct_contract fc where fc.project_id in (select t.project_id from fct_project t where t.credit_bp_id in (select hr.bp_id from hls_bp_master_relation hr where hr.relation_bp_id = #{bpId} and 'Y'= #{groupFlag} union select #{bpId} bp_id from dual))) and fqc.cf_item=54

select nvl(sum(nvl(fpq.finance_amount, 0)), 0) from fct_project_quotation fpq where fpq.project_id in (select t.project_id from fct_project t where t.credit_bp_id in (select hr.bp_id from hls_bp_master_relation hr where hr.relation_bp_id = #{bpId} and 'Y'= #{groupFlag} union select #{bpId} bp_id from dual))
mapper.update: update hls_credit_line hcl set hcl.withdraw_balance= nvl( ( select round(sum((lcp.planned_due_amount-nvl(lcp.due_amount,0))*ifnull (lcw.exchange_rate,1)),2) from lon_contract lc join lon_contract_withdraw lcw on lcw.contract_id=lc.contract_id and lcw.withdraw_status IN ('APPROVED','PENDING') and lcw.data_class='NORMAL' join lon_contract_repayment lcp on lcp.withdraw_id=lcw.withdraw_id and lcp.cf_item=301 where lc.rele_credit_flag='Y' and hcl.credit_line_id=lc.credit_line_id),0) + nvl( (select capss.subscribe_amount-nvl(cpe.al_release_amount,0) from ct_abs_product_subscribe capss left join ( select r.subscribe_id, sum(r.release_amount) al_release_amount from ct_abs_product_release r where r.release_status='CONFIRM' group by r.subscribe_id ) cpe on cpe.subscribe_id=capss.subscribe_id where capss.rele_credit_flag='Y' and hcl.credit_line_id=capss.credit_line_id and capss.subscribe_status='CONFIRM'),0) where hcl.credit_line_id=#{creditLineId} and nvl(hcl.cancel_flag,'N')='N'

update hls_credit_line hcl set hcl.credit_exposure_amt=( case when hcl.document_type='REVOLVING' then nvl(hcl.withdraw_balance,0) else nvl( ( select sum(round(nvl(lcw.due_amount,0)*nvl(lcw.exchange_rate,1),2)) from lon_contract_withdraw lcw join lon_contract lc on lc.contract_id=lcw.contract_id where lcw.withdraw_status in ('APPROVED', 'PENDING') and lcw.data_class= 'NORMAL' and lc.rele_credit_flag='Y' and lc.credit_line_id=hcl.credit_line_id) ,0) end ) where hcl.credit_line_id=#{creditLineId} and nvl(hcl.cancel_flag,'N')='N'
